items.name: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Oct. 16, 2026
items.summary: The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week.  In Yokosuka, Japan The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group docked Friday at Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka. This marks the first time in four years that a non-forward deployed carrier has pulled into CFAY.  The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), cruiser USS Chosin (CG 65) and destroyer USS Decatur (DDG 73).
